pooled.span: Incidence of composite endpoint As far as general ACS patients are concerned, 5 studies, including a total of 33,258 patients, assessed the incidence of the composite endpoint. Low heterogeneity was shown among the studies [P = 0.67, I2 = 0%], and according to the fixed-effects model, the incidence of the composite endpoint in the ticagrelor group was significantly lower than the incidence in the clopidogrel group [OR = 0.83, 95%CI (0.77, 0.90), P<0.00001] ( Fig 4 )

scope_note: Topic primary outcome: Major adverse cardiovascular events: cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction, or stroke. General ACS composite of MI/CV death/stroke versus clopidogrel is closest. Five table rows with outcome code one retained as printed reference/year labels. Do not substitute diabetes-only or prasugrel contrasts.
